name: Maou ga Calling!
source:
When the dashing demon king invades our human world... The only hero is a fujoshi...

Who would ever believe it's nerdy girl Sanae that will send the lord of darkness back to his realm? Somehow Sanae has to save the world and banish the demon king to Hell. She will harness the power of her virginity, face off against evil so handsome it will make you weep, and achieve heroism!

Oh and there's loads of ecchi. Enjoy!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ104655.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当英俊潇洒的魔王入侵人类世界时……唯一的勇者竟是个腐女……

谁会相信，那个宅气十足的女孩早苗，竟会是将黑暗之王送回魔界的人？总之，早苗得设法拯救世界，把魔王赶回地狱。她将运用自己的处女之力，迎战帅得令人落泪的邪恶存在，成就勇者之名！

对了，还有许多色色的情节。敬请享受！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ104655.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
